about: Fixed lines the live engine must reproduce. Each total was derived from HTSUS 2026 Rev. 21 chapter 99 (U.S. notes 16, 20/31, 50, 52) and the MFN column; derivation in `why`. Built 2026-10-26 from the scout benchmark of that day. Update a line only with a primary-source reason in `why`.
